neighbours.label: ' keep' as a verb of protecting something for someone (offers to keep her secret), and ' maintain'
fire: He offers to keep her secret when the king asks.
Her brother promised to keep the plan hidden from them.
You must not construct, keep, maintain, or sell a trap.
The nurse agreed to keep his secret until morning.
She swore to keep the letter from her husband.
They are allowed to maintain their old customs here.
He vowed to keep the truth from his family.
The maid offered to keep the child safe that night.
